flirtingMeet.title: Meeting Someone New at a Café
flirtingMeet.screenplay: Strike up a friendly conversation, share a little about yourself, exchange interests, and decide whether to meet again.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice a light flirting conversation at a café — hellos, compliments, and asking for a number. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Is this seat taken? The place is packed today.
chat.outgoing1: Oh, go ahead! I was just waiting for my coffee.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! I'm Alex, by the way. What brings you here?
chat.botReply: Nice to meet you. Do you come here often?

flirtingAwkward.title: Handling an Awkward Moment
flirtingAwkward.screenplay: Recover from a misunderstanding or awkward pause, apologize lightly, and steer the chat back to a comfortable topic.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice handling an awkward moment in a flirty chat — light apology and recovery. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Wait… I think you mixed up my name.
chat.outgoing1: Oh no — sorry! That was embarrassing. Can we start over?
chat.incoming2Rest: . I'm Maya.
chat.botReply: No hard feelings. What were we talking about?

flirtingAskOut.title: Asking Someone Out
flirtingAskOut.screenplay: After a short chat, suggest meeting again — coffee, a walk, or a movie — and handle a yes or a soft no gracefully.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking someone out politely. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: I've really enjoyed talking with you.
chat.outgoing1: Me too. Would you like to grab coffee sometime this week?
chat.incoming2Rest: . What day works for you?
chat.botReply: Saturday afternoon is free for me.

flirtingCompliment.title: Giving a Friendly Compliment
flirtingCompliment.screenplay: Start with a light compliment, keep it respectful, and see if the other person wants to keep talking.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice giving a friendly compliment — short, kind, and natural. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Oh, excuse me — I almost bumped into you.
chat.outgoing1: No worries! By the way, I like your jacket.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! That's sweet of you to say.
chat.botReply: Are you waiting for someone, or just hanging out?

freeTalkHobby.title: Talking About Hobbies
freeTalkHobby.screenplay: Chat freely about free-time activities, ask follow-up questions, share preferences, and suggest trying something new together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice free discussion about hobbies — asking, answering, and reacting naturally. I'll explain first, then we'll talk. Ready?
chat.incoming1: So, what do you usually do on weekends?
chat.outgoing1: I like hiking and watching films. How about you?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! I've been meaning to try hiking more. Any favorite trails?
chat.botReply: That sounds perfect. Want to go together sometime?

freeTalkDisagree.title: Politely Disagreeing About Hobbies
freeTalkDisagree.screenplay: Disagree politely about a hobby preference, explain your view, and keep the conversation friendly.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice disagreeing politely about hobbies. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: I think hiking is boring.
chat.outgoing1: I get that — for me it's relaxing. What do you prefer instead?
chat.incoming2Rest: . I like indoor climbing more.
chat.botReply: Maybe we can try each other's hobby once.

freeTalkMovies.title: Talking About Movies
freeTalkMovies.screenplay: Recommend a movie, ask about genres, and react to each other's favorites.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about movies — genres, favorites, recommendations. I'll explain first, then we'll chat. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Seen any good movies lately?
chat.outgoing1: Yes — a comedy last week. Do you like comedies?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Any titles you'd recommend?
chat.botReply: I'll send you my top three tonight.

freeTalkWeekend.title: Talking About Weekend Plans
freeTalkWeekend.screenplay: Share weekend plans, ask about theirs, and suggest a simple activity you could do together.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice chatting about weekend plans. I'll explain first, then we'll talk. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Any plans for the weekend?
chat.outgoing1: I might go to the park. What about you?
chat.incoming2Rest: ! I was thinking of a museum.
chat.botReply: Want to meet for a short walk on Sunday?

coffee.title: Ordering at the Coffee Shop
coffee.screenplay: Order your favorite drink, ask about sizes and extras, confirm your total, and pick up your coffee at the counter.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice ordering at a coffee shop — hello, sizes, extras. I'll explain a little first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Welcome! What can I get started for you today?
chat.outgoing1: Hi! I'd like a medium latte, please.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Would you like that hot or iced, and any extras?
chat.botReply: Great choice. Anything else with your order?

coffeeQueue.title: Waiting in the Coffee Line
coffeeQueue.screenplay: Stand in line at a busy café, chat politely with the person ahead of you, hold your spot, and get ready to order when it's your turn.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice waiting in a coffee line — small talk, holding your place, and moving up. I'll explain a little first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: This line is moving slowly today, huh?
chat.outgoing1: Yeah — mornings are always busy here.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Are you getting the usual, or trying something new?
chat.botReply: Nice. Looks like you're next — good luck with your order!

coffeeRecommendation.title: Asking for a Drink Recommendation
coffeeRecommendation.screenplay: Ask the barista what they recommend, compare a few drinks, choose size and milk options, then place your order confidently.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking a barista for recommendations — flavors, sizes, milk options. I'll explain a little first, then we'll role-play. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hey! Need a suggestion, or do you already know what you want?
chat.outgoing1: I'd love a recommendation — something not too bitter.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Our honey oat latte is popular, or the caramel cold brew if you want iced.
chat.botReply: Great pick. What size should I make that?

coffeeWrongOrder.title: Fixing a Wrong Coffee Order
coffeeWrongOrder.screenplay: Politely explain that your drink is wrong, describe what you ordered, ask for a remake or swap, and thank the barista.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice fixing a wrong coffee order — staying polite, explaining the mistake, and asking for a remake. I'll teach a few phrases first, then we'll act it out. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Here's your order — medium iced latte. Enjoy!
chat.outgoing1: Sorry, I think this might be wrong. I asked for a hot oat milk latte.
chat.incoming2Rest: — my mistake! I'll remake that for you right away.
chat.botReply: Thanks for your patience. Hot oat milk latte coming up.

directions.title: Asking for Directions on the Street
directions.screenplay: Ask for directions to a place, find out how to get to the subway or bus, get information about tickets, and listen to restaurant recommendations.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking for directions on the street. I'll explain a little first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Hi there! You look a bit lost — need help finding something?
chat.outgoing1: Yes, I'm looking for the nearest subway station.
chat.incoming2Rest: ! Walk two blocks that way, then turn left. You'll see the entrance.
chat.botReply: You're welcome! Want a restaurant tip near the station too?

directionsWrongWay.title: Correcting Wrong Directions
directionsWrongWay.screenplay: Realize the directions were wrong, politely check again, and get clearer landmark-based instructions.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice fixing wrong directions politely. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: Did you find the park?
chat.outgoing1: I think I went the wrong way. Could you explain it again with landmarks?
chat.incoming2Rest: — walk past the red bookstore, then left at the fountain.
chat.botReply: If you see the bakery, you've gone too far.

directionsTransit.title: Asking About Bus or Subway Routes
directionsTransit.screenplay: Ask which line to take, how many stops, and where to transfer to reach your destination.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking about bus and subway routes. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?
chat.incoming1: Need transit help?
chat.outgoing1: Yes — which subway line goes to the museum?
chat.incoming2Rest: three stops, then transfer to the green line.
chat.botReply: The whole trip is about twenty minutes.

directionsLost.title: Asking for Help When You're Lost
directionsLost.screenplay: Admit you're lost, describe where you need to go, and confirm the directions before you leave.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice asking for help when you're lost. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?
chat.incoming1: You look a little lost — need a hand?
chat.outgoing1: Yes, please. I'm trying to find City Hall.
chat.incoming2Rest: — go straight two blocks, then turn right.
chat.botReply: Want me to point it out on the map too?

interview.title: Job Interview
interview.screenplay: Introduce yourself, answer common interview questions, talk about your experience, and ask about the role and next steps.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice a job interview. I'll explain a little first, then we'll act it out — I'll interview you, then we switch. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: Of course. I'm excited to be here and share my experience.
chat.incoming2Rest: . Tell me about a recent project you're proud of.
chat.botReply: That's impressive. What questions do you have about the role?

interviewSalary.title: Discussing Salary Expectations
interviewSalary.screenplay: Talk about salary range politely, ask about benefits, and keep the tone professional.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice discussing salary expectations professionally. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?

chat.incoming2Rest: . Benefits also include remote days and learning budget.
chat.botReply: Are benefits important in your decision?

interviewExperience.title: Describing Work Experience
interviewExperience.screenplay: Walk through a recent role, your responsibilities, and one achievement with numbers if possible.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice describing work experience clearly. I'll explain first, then we'll act it out. Sound good?

chat.outgoing1: I coordinated a small team and improved our delivery time.
chat.incoming2Rest: . By how much did you improve it?
chat.botReply: What was the hardest part of that job?

interviewStrengths.title: Talking About Your Strengths
interviewStrengths.screenplay: Describe two strengths with short examples and connect them to the job.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice talking about your strengths in an interview. I'll explain first, then we'll role-play. Ready?

missedTrain.title: You Missed Your Train
missedTrain.screenplay: You missed your train and ask a station staff member for help — explain where you're going, find the next train, and get directions to the platform.

chat.briefing: Hi! Today we'll practice what to say when you miss your train at a station. I'll teach a few phrases first, then we'll role-play. Ready?

chat.incoming2Rest: . Let me check the next available train for you.
chat.botReply: Would you prefer the fastest option or the cheapest one?

supportedLanguages.question: Which languages does the app support?
supportedLanguages.answer: Lingola's interface is available in English, German, Italian, French, Turkish, Japanese, Spanish, Russian, Hindi, Portuguese, and Simplified Chinese.

howAiWorks.question: How does the AI work?
howAiWorks.answer: The AI interacts with you like a real tutor. It analyzes your conversations, detects mistakes, and offers personalized feedback based on your progress.

offlineUse.question: Can I use the app offline?
offlineUse.answer: Yes. You can download certain lessons and conversation scenarios in advance and use them offline. However, live chat requires an internet connection.

isFree.question: Is the app free?
isFree.answer: The basic version is free. With Premium, you get advanced chat scenarios, pronunciation analysis, and personal tutor mode.

pronunciationEval.question: How is my pronunciation evaluated?
pronunciationEval.answer: The app analyzes your voice and uses AI-powered speech recognition to score your accent and pronunciation. Words you need to improve are highlighted.

dailyPractice.question: Do I need to practice daily?
dailyPractice.answer: Yes. The system tracks your progress every day. Just 10–15 minutes of speaking practice per day can noticeably speed up your language learning.

levelDetermination.question: How is my learning level determined?
levelDetermination.answer: A short level check when you first sign in analyzes your current knowledge. After that, the AI automatically recommends lessons suited to your level.

realPeopleChat.question: Can I talk with real people?
realPeopleChat.answer: Yes. Premium users can schedule short practice sessions with real tutors.

dataSecurity.question: Is my data safe?
dataSecurity.answer: Absolutely. All conversations and user data are stored encrypted. Your personal information is never shared with third parties.

disableReminders.question: How do I turn off daily reminders?
disableReminders.answer: Go to Profile settings, open Notifications, and change the reminder frequency or turn notifications off completely.
